draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.12, the 129th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 14th of 20 at DE. He went 76th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (129th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 12 sacks in 2023, 4th of 20 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Denver Broncos. 30 career games and 0 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 0.0% (95th percentile). Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 edge rusher who played: 2.5 sacks against a median of 2.0, above the norm.
